title: Hardcoded fallback company name 'Decades Contracting Group' in production render path
detail: Line 50: c.dcfg_contractor_legal_name || 'Decades Contracting Group' — when the contractor legal name is null, the component renders the literal string 'Decades Contracting Group'. Per feedback_no_customer_or_people_names_in_production.md, no customer or company names should appear as hardcoded strings in production code.
recommendedFix: Change the fallback from 'Decades Contracting Group' to a generic dash or 'Not specified'.

title: Document link uses emoji as sole link text — screen readers announce Unicode codepoint, not purpose
detail: Line 71: the document link renders emoji character as visible text. Screen readers may announce this as a codepoint, not 'View Document'. Same pattern at ViewCustomerGroups.jsx:118 and ViewSplitPanel.jsx:53.
evidence: ContractRowDetail.jsx:71 — link text is emoji + 'View Document'. ViewCustomerGroups.jsx:118 — emoji only. ViewSplitPanel.jsx:53 — emoji only.
recommendedFix: Add aria-label='View document' to the anchor element in all three files.
